thread:
maria: Kicking off release v2.14.0 to eu-west during change window — gradual ramp, starting at 10% traffic to embeddings and rerank routes. DeployBot kicked the job off.

deploy-bot: [automated] rollout started · job_id=rl-20260321-88a3 · step=gradual_ramp · targets=[embeddings,rerank] · expected_steps=5
sam: Heads up — quick eyeball on SLO dashboard shows embeddings.p95 jumped 130ms -> 360ms in the last 2 minutes, link: https://console.redwood/slo/embeddings?range=5m
lee: Any 5xx spike or only latency?
sam: 5xx small uptick 0.2% -> 0.6%, but latency breach is the bigger problem. Our SLO for embeddings.p95 is 99.5pct; current signal is at ~97.8pct over 3m, starting to breach error budget.
ops-bot: [alert] SLO breach detected: embeddings.p95 > threshold for 3m. Suggested action: freeze ramp (set new version weight -> 0) and run fast circuit probe.
maria: Freezing ramp now, please quarantine the release on embeddings route only — do NOT touch rerank yet. Can we do a partial rollback to v2.13.7 for embeddings while leaving other routes intact?
jordan: I recommend partial rollback on embeddings-route. Initiating route-only rollback and draining v2.14.0 from embeddings. If the rollback fails, we'll fallback to full rollback.
deploy-bot: [automated] action=adjust_weights · route=embeddings · from={v2.14.0:10} -> to={v2.14.0:0,v2.13.7:100} · job_id=rl-20260321-88a3-rollback · logs=/ops/logs/rl-20260321-88a3-rollback
maria: Command I ran (for audit): `curl -X POST https://api.redwood/internal/route-weight -H 'Authorization: Bearer $AUDIT_TOKEN' -d '{"route":"embeddings","weights":{"v2.14.0":0,"v2.13.7":100}}'`
sam: Watching the dashboard — p95 trending back down to 140ms, 5xx falling to 0.15% :thumbsup:
lee: Leaving canary logs in the thread for triage: https://logs.redwood/stream/rl-20260321-88a3 · grep for `kv-cache` and `attention` around the spike timestamps
maria: Good catch everyone. I'll update the release notes: mark v2.14.0 as "quarantined for embeddings latency" and create a follow-up ticket for eng-runtime triage (assign @eng-runtime). Add a short rollback blurb and action items.
jordan: Suggest we add a focused perf test for long-context embedding workloads to the release checklist before next ramp.
maria: Agreed. Closing this rollout for embeddings — hold any further ramps until triage. Thanks all.
ops-bot: [automated] thread closed by maria · summary=partial_rollback_complete · followup_ticket=ENG-4892
